title: View from Ocean Avenue
content: Today we painted a view from Ocean Avenue across Gooseneck Cove to Seafair (formerly 'Terre Mare'), the home of Jay Leno in in Newport, Rhode Island.It's one of the paintings I’ll offer atMariner Galleryat the plein-air event 6:00-9:00 Sunday.It's casein on panel. When it's varnished up and framed, it will look and feel just like an oil.
